thesis: This episode argues that investors should focus on high-quality compounders with strong management teams that prioritize innovation over short-term KPIs, citing Amazon and Constellation Software as examples. It further contends that true luxury brands like Hermes, Rolex, and Ferrari maintain their status and value through deliberate supply capping and exclusivity strategies rather than volume expansion.
